title: A Visit to Their Aunt
setting: Their aunt's cozy room in her house, on an autumn afternoon.

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans)

characters.name: Leo
characters.look: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie)

sentences.en: In October, Mia and Leo visit their aunt.
sentences.zh: 十月，米娅和里奥去看望他们的姨妈。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) walk up to a small house with orange autumn leaves on the ground.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Mia and Leo arriving at a house in autumn; 'October' can't be shown exactly.

sentences.en: Their aunt is resting in her sunny room.
sentences.zh: 他们的姨妈正在她阳光充足的房间里休息。
sentences.scene_prompt: Their aunt (a kind woman of about fifty with grey curly hair, gold glasses and a long green dress) rests in an armchair with a blanket in a sunny room.

sentences.en: She opens Mia's card and starts to smile.
sentences.zh: 她打开米娅的贺卡，开始露出笑容。
sentences.scene_prompt: In her armchair, their aunt (a kind woman of about fifty with grey curly hair, gold glasses and a long green dress) opens a handmade card with a flower picture and smiles; Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) stands beside her.

sentences.en: "I feel fine today," she says to them.
sentences.zh: “我今天感觉很好。”她对他们说。
sentences.scene_prompt: Their aunt (a kind woman of about fifty with grey curly hair, gold glasses and a long green dress) sits up, looking well and cheerful, and talks to Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie).
sentences.draw_note: Shows the aunt looking well and talking to them; her spoken words can't be shown.

sentences.en: She lets Leo cut the cake for everyone.
sentences.zh: 她让里奥给大家切蛋糕。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) cuts a round cake on a small table while their aunt (a kind woman of about fifty with grey curly hair, gold glasses and a long green dress) watches.

sentences.en: When they finish, they watch birds from the window.
sentences.zh: 吃完以后，他们从窗户看鸟。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans), Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) and their aunt (a kind woman of about fifty with grey curly hair, gold glasses and a long green dress) look out of a window at birds in a tree, empty plates behind them.

sentences.en: Sometimes she tells funny stories about her life.
sentences.zh: 她有时会讲她生活中的趣事。
sentences.scene_prompt: Their aunt (a kind woman of about fifty with grey curly hair, gold glasses and a long green dress) tells a story with lively hands while Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) laugh.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the aunt telling a story and the children laughing; 'sometimes' and the story itself can't be shown.

sentences.en: "Our plan for tomorrow is a picnic," says Mia.
sentences.zh: “我们明天的计划是去野餐。”米娅说。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) shows their aunt (a kind woman of about fifty with grey curly hair, gold glasses and a long green dress) a crayon drawing of a picnic blanket and a basket under a tree; the aunt claps her hands.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Mia's drawing of a picnic and the happy aunt; 'tomorrow' can't be shown.
